title: Which streaming service does the question want?

questions.ask: Does the scenario already use Kafka clients, Kafka Connect or Kafka Streams?
Is the only job to deliver records into S3, Redshift or OpenSearch?
Must several consumers read every record, or replay it later?
questions.yes: Kinesis Data Streams (enhanced fan-out for many readers)

questions.ask: Is each message handled once by one worker, with no replay?
questions.yes: Amazon SQS (a queue, not a stream)

otherwise: Kinesis Data Streams in on-demand mode: the least to operate
caption: Read the stem from the top: the first question answered yes decides.
alt: Decision ladder: existing Kafka points to MSK; delivery only points to Firehose; several readers or replay points to Kinesis Data Streams; one worker per message points to SQS.
